And that pipeline I think is a serious threat to our national security, but also to the national security of Europe. What it enables, it essentially enriches Russia. If you look at Russia, and if you look at Putin right now, Putin is effectively a petrol tyrant. He uses oil and natural gas to enrich his military aggression. I introduced legislation that is designed to be targeted sanctions to stop the Nord Stream 2 bill from being constructed. And it is specifically directed at the ships that lay deep sea pipe. Now that was an overwhelming bipartisan vote of support and I'm hopeful that when Congress gets back in September that we take it up and pass it into law. My objective is to stop this pipeline from being built, which is unambiguously good for Europe. It's unambiguously good for the United States, and it's unambiguously bad for Russia.
